import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "AlterV10Lang": ["30- bis 39-Jährige", "30- bis 39-Jährige", "30- bis 39-Jährige", "30- bis 39-Jährige", "30- bis 39-Jährige"],
    "HundefarbeText": ["beige", "beige", "beige/schwarz", "beige/schwarz", "beige/schwarz"],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create a count plot for the number of dogs by color
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='HundefarbeText', hue='AlterV10Lang', palette='pastel')

plt.title('Number of Dogs by Color and Age Group')
plt.xlabel('Dog Color')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
